plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HOutfits
plugins.Punchline: Apply full sets to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
plugins.Description: Lists the game's complete named sets and applies a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
plugins.Changelog: 0.3.0: adds optional NPC weapon copying. Turn on "Include weapons" and applying a whole NPC also copies its main-hand and off-hand (experimental: Glamourer may skip a weapon that isn't valid for your current class, and clicking a single weapon icon always applies it). The "Include accessories" toggle now sits on each tab beside that tab's own options; on the NPC tab, "Apply name", "Include weapons" and "Include accessories" now share one row.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: Cosmic Claw
plugins.Description: Play the Cosmic Predator's Magitek Claw Sweep animation on demand, once or on a loop, while you're riding it. Purely cosmetic and local-only; nothing is sent to the server. Works on both the Cosmic Predator and the standard Magitek Predator. Commands: /clawsweep and /clawsweeploop.
plugins.Changelog: 0.1.1: loop now repeats until toggled off; also works on the standard Magitek Predator (mount 121); tidier command help and quieter chat.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HMoniker
plugins.Description: Changes your display name. Local only: visible only to yourself outside of HMS (HMapSync) sessions.
plugins.Changelog: 1.4.0: adds a "Hide title" toggle that hides your nameplate title (the same field Honorific sets). In an HMS session, hiding your title also hides it for other members.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: Begone!
plugins.Punchline: Out of sight, out of mind.
plugins.Description: Hide NPCs with a single click
plugins.Changelog: 0.3.0: adds a global toggle to hide the ! and ? quest markers over NPCs' heads, keeping the NPCs (cosmetic, client-side).

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HMapSync (HMS)
plugins.Description: Load any in-game map client-side and explore it solo or with up to 20 friends, behind a packet filter that keeps the server seeing you as idle in your room. Shared weather, BGM and time; client-side mounts, emotes and minions; carpet floors for spots without collision; head-tilt and gaze sync for roleplay; and proximity say/yell passthrough. Co-op needs a relay key (closed beta); solo mode never connects to the relay.
plugins.Changelog: 1.0.1.0: cram any weather onto any map via a new Extra presets library; crammed city skies (marked *) now cycle a full day and sync across a session, with a City sky variants picker; /hms setweather <id> sets weather from chat; the invisible barriers around boss arenas, dungeon sections, quest phases and NPC pens now drop automatically on every map load (/hms dropcolliders off to restore); locked emotes now trigger from the emote menu, /emote text and hotbar macros during a session; Solution Nine and Tuliyollal now hide post-battle debris for a clean free-roam.
